description: Authenticate with your MisarReach account via browser — no API key copy-paste needed. Opens the MisarReach authorization page where you review the request and click 'Authorize'. The API key is delivered straight back to this client and saved to ~/.misarreach/config.json.

app_url.description: MisarReach base URL. Only needed for self-hosted instances.

force.description: Re-authenticate even if a working key is stored (issues a new key).

port.description: Local callback port (9201–9299). Random by default.

name: login
